scope: USDJPY 2023/2024 lineage correction, Families G/H/I, recovery diagnostics and Family J WIP
elapsed_observation: more than 100 minutes of sequential research and repository work
summary: The dominant delays were research-governance, evaluator reproducibility, CI granularity and state-synchronization failures rather than a Rakuten MT4 runner failure.

incidents.failure: The initial next action would have transformed the historical 2024 authority instead of aligning 2023 to it.
incidents.repair: Historical 2024 was frozen and only 2023 was transformed under registry v25 and later.
incidents.prevention: Before any cross-year transformation, freeze source_authority_period, transformed_period and immutable_periods in a machine-readable authority-direction gate.

incidents.failure: The accepted 2023 legacy-2024 builder source was not committed; only an execution SHA-256 was retained.
incidents.repair: Result hashes and exact 2024 reproduction were recorded, but independent source-level reproduction remains incomplete.
incidents.prevention: No scientific evaluator may run until its source is committed on the preregistration branch and passes syntax/static preflight.

incidents.failure: A new local reconstruction of the 2023 legacy timestamp transform produced 1,428 shifted M15 bars, while the accepted result records 1,543.
incidents.repair: The portability screen was classified as technical orientation only and blocked from scientific interpretation.
incidents.prevention: The exact transformer source and a 1,543-shift reconciliation test are mandatory before any new 2023 signal or strategy screen.

incidents.failure: Family G discovered missing exact checkpoint bars only after family preregistration.
incidents.repair: A first-available-market-bar execution amendment was frozen before candidate metrics.
incidents.prevention: Every family preregistration must include a technical feasibility inventory for checkpoints, missing bars, period endpoints and delayed execution.

incidents.failure: The first Family H evaluator invocation failed because period subsets retained non-contiguous pandas indices.
incidents.repair: Only RangeIndex normalization was changed; the attempt was logged as technical incomplete.
incidents.prevention: A universal evaluator preflight must assert RangeIndex, timestamp monotonicity, key uniqueness, one-row execution and output schema before the full grid.

incidents.failure: The memory validator failed when a newly closed family existed only in the active ledger addendum.
incidents.repair: The validator was extended to resolve the base ledger plus the active addendum.
incidents.prevention: Run the canonical memory validator locally before opening a PR and test the full base-plus-addendum graph.

incidents.failure: Four output SHA values in the recovery diagnosis were transcribed incorrectly.
incidents.prevention: Result manifests and file SHA-256 values must be generated directly from output files; manual hash entry is prohibited.

incidents.failure: Nine sequential PRs and repeated CI polls were used for closely related stages, increasing queue and review latency.
incidents.repair: Each scientific result was eventually merged only after both CI checks passed.
incidents.prevention: Use one atomic branch per research stage, prepare result/report/ledger/registry/manifest together, run local checks once, then open one PR.

incidents.failure: Notion Current State remained at registry v24/RQ-011 while GitHub advanced to v33/RQ-019.
incidents.repair: Task pages were partially updated, but the main index remained stale.
incidents.prevention: A GitHub merge is not stage-complete until Notion commit, registry, question and next action are updated and fetched back for readback verification.

incidents.failure: Family J was described as frozen before outcome evaluation even though reversal P/L is algebraically derivable from already opened Family I trade outcomes.
incidents.repair: Family J remains an unmerged WIP and is blocked from canonical activation.
incidents.prevention: Any deterministic payoff transformation must disclose algebraic outcome derivability; it cannot be labeled blind preregistration after source outcomes are known.

incidents.failure: Research proceeded through several local F05/B02 repair families before applying an impact-sufficiency screen against the total development deficit.
incidents.repair: F05 repair was stopped when its maximum observed development effect was too small to close the 2023 deficit.
incidents.prevention: Before preregistration, estimate mechanism reach, affected count and maximum development impact. Reject families that cannot plausibly close the identified loss source.

incidents.failure: The Family J branch stopped after three files without ledger, registry, manifest, PR or CI.
incidents.repair: It is explicitly classified as abandoned WIP, not canonical evidence.
incidents.prevention: At interruption, leave a machine-readable WIP receipt with branch, head SHA, completed files, missing files and exact next action.

incidents.failure: Old one-time marker PRs remain open and can be mistaken for current work.
incidents.repair: They are excluded from current authority.
incidents.prevention: Perform repository hygiene after each major stage and close superseded marker/one-shot PRs after evidence retention is confirmed.

required_process_changes: exact 2023 transformer reconciliation before further 2023 candidate work
